user.title: Ecotricity
user.description: Enter the ICP number for your connection; find it on the "Electricity Usage Details" section of your bill. If you want to track your half-hourly usage and billing data, you must also provide your customer portal login details below.

data_description.icp: The 15-character ICP number on the Electricity Usage Details page of your bill, for example `ICP 0000123456AB1C2`.
data_description.account_number: Optional. The account number you log in to the Ecotricity customer portal with. If you leave this blank, no usage data will be imported.
data_description.password: Optional. Your Ecotricity customer portal password. If you leave this blank, no usage data will be imported.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.description: Choose the Ecotricity plan this ICP is currently on. You can change this later in the integration's options.

data_description.plan_id: The plans Ecotricity offers for this ICP, by the names on its website. Prices are based on the plan you choose.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the Ecotricity portal again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the saved login for ICP {icp}. Enter your account number and password.

data_description.account_number: The account number you log in to the Ecotricity customer portal with.

reconfigure.title: Change portal login
reconfigure.description: Update the customer portal login for ICP {icp}. Clear both fields to stop importing usage data.

data_description.account_number: The account number you log in to the Ecotricity customer portal with. Leave it blank to stop importing usage data.
data_description.password: Your Ecotricity customer portal password. Leave it blank to stop importing usage data.

error.credentials_required: Enter your account number and password.

abort.already_configured: This ICP is already set up.

data_description.include_gst_export: Add 15% GST to export prices. Ecotricity charges GST on your bill's total, so export credits are worth 15% more than the published rate.
data_description.plan_id: The Ecotricity plan this ICP is currently on. Prices are based on this plan.

attestation_failed.message: The Ecotricity onboarding site refused the request. Its security check may have changed.

invalid_auth.message: The Ecotricity portal rejected the saved login.

fetch_waiting.message: Couldn't fetch the chosen plan's pricing from Ecotricity, so it won't be tried again until {time}.

refresh_failed.message: Couldn't refresh the data from Ecotricity. Check the logs for details.

attestation_failed.title: Ecotricity pricing can't be fetched
attestation_failed.description: The Ecotricity onboarding site has rejected the integration's requests several times in a row. The site has probably changed how it checks visitors. Check for an update to this integration.

tou_chart_unreadable.title: Time-of-use hours for {plan} can't be read
tou_chart_unreadable.description: The integration reads the peak and off-peak hours from Ecotricity's plan charts, and the latest chart couldn't be read or didn't match the plan's prices. The current price and period sensors are unavailable until this is fixed. Check for an update to this integration.

plan_not_found.title: Your Ecotricity plan is no longer listed
plan_not_found.description: The plan chosen for this ICP isn't among the plans Ecotricity currently lists for it, so prices are being worked out from {default} instead. Choose your plan again in the integration's options.

network_category_mismatch.title: Ecotricity plan and network price category don't match for ICP {icp}
network_category_mismatch.description:
Ecotricity lists your plan ({plan}) prices with your network's {plan_category} category rates, but you're currently being charged using {icp_category} category rates. This means you are not paying the advertised rates as they appear on the Ecotricity website. Normally your network would move your ICP to the correct price category when you join Ecotricity, but the registry data for your ICP does not currently reflect this.

It is recommended that you **contact Ecotricity and request your ICP be moved from {icp_category} to {plan_category}** so that you are billed the correct advertised rates shown on their website. This request usually takes 4 to 6 weeks to be actioned, and this repair notice will automatically go away once the correct price category is shown for your ICP.

network_category_unpriced.title: Network prices for {plan} may not match your bill
network_category_unpriced.description: Ecotricity lists {plan} with the network's {plan_category} rates, but the registry has your ICP on {icp_category}, and the network charges that category's rates. None of the plans Ecotricity lists for your ICP has the {icp_category} rates, so prices are still worked out with the {plan_category} ones and the network part of your bill may differ. Ask Ecotricity to have your ICP moved to {plan_category}, or choose a plan for {icp_category} in the integration's options.

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Fetches the latest pricing and usage from Ecotricity now, instead of waiting for the next scheduled update.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The ICP to refresh. Can be left out if you only have one.
